    CategoryTheory.Mat_.linear

    Linear structure on additive matrix categories #

    The additive envelope CategoryTheory.Mat_ C has pointwise scalar multiplication on its Hom matrices. This file records that composition is linear in both variables when C is a linear category.

    source
    @[instance_reducible]
    instance CategoryTheory.Mat_.linear {R : Type w} [Semiring R] {C : Type u} [Category.{v, u} C] [Preadditive C] [Linear R C] :
    Linear R (Mat_ C)

    The additive matrix category of an R-linear category is R-linear, with pointwise scalar multiplication on Hom matrices.
